==Transportation==
The level 13 [[Wilderness Obelisk|Wilderness obelisk]] is east of the Enclave. There are also a few safe methods of reaching Ferox Enclave that do not require players to traverse the Wilderness:
* A [[ring of dueling]] will teleport directly here.
* [[Minigame Teleport]] to the [[Last Man Standing]] and [[Clan Wars]] [[minigame]]s.
* Exiting the [[Castle Wars]] area in a free-to-play world.
* Using a [[waka canoe]] along the [[River Lum]] to row here (requires level 57 [[Woodcutting]]).
